The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
